# Pacifics

> Pacifics is an AI-powered cybersecurity intelligence platform that helps organizations understand security risk in context. It acts as a Security Context Layer across the security ecosystem, combining a Security Context Graph, Attack Path Intelligence, and Controlled AI.

Pacifics connects fragmented security signals — cloud resources, assets, vulnerabilities, identities, permissions, exposures, and sensitive data — into a unified graph, then reasons over that graph to surface the attack paths that actually matter.

- Website: https://pacifics.in
- App: https://app.pacifics.in
- Docs: https://docs.pacifics.in
- Source: https://github.com/pacificsai/pacifics-docs
- License: Apache-2.0

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](https://docs.pacifics.in/docs/getting-started/introduction): What Pacifics is and what you can do with it.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.pacifics.in/docs/getting-started/quickstart): Get Pacifics running against your environment in a few steps.
- [Connect Your Environment](https://docs.pacifics.in/docs/getting-started/connect-environment): Connect cloud, identity, and source-control data sources.
- [Your First Attack Path](https://docs.pacifics.in/docs/getting-started/first-attack-path): Read and act on your first attack path.

## Platform

- [Security Context Graph](https://docs.pacifics.in/docs/platform/security-context-graph): The unified graph of assets, identities, permissions, vulnerabilities, exposure, and sensitive data.
- [Attack Path Intelligence](https://docs.pacifics.in/docs/platform/attack-path-intelligence): How Pacifics traces and prioritizes realistic attack paths.
- [AI Security Reasoning](https://docs.pacifics.in/docs/platform/ai-security-reasoning): Controlled AI reasoning grounded in your security data.

## Guides

- [Investigate with AI](https://docs.pacifics.in/docs/guides/investigate-with-ai): Investigate a finding or attack path end to end with AI.
- [Explore Attack Paths](https://docs.pacifics.in/docs/guides/explore-attack-paths): Navigate and filter attack paths to focus on what matters.
